stem.text: Structural isomerism and stereoisomerism should be considered when answering this question.

Each of the following carbonyl compounds is reacted with $\text{NaBH}_4$. The product of each reaction is heated with $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ at $600\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$, generating one product or a mixture of isomers.
Which carbonyl compound will produce the most isomers?
